# Regression fixtures

These three small, derived CSV fixtures are copied unchanged from the thesis
analysis checkout. They support registered-output regression tests, not raw MRIO
inputs or a complete empirical archive. Column names and units are preserved.

- `annual_hierarchy.csv`: originally `docs/analysis/static_inputs/annual_hierarchy.csv`.
- `kyoto_period_group_effects.csv` and `kyoto_period_group_interactions.csv`:
  originally `docs/analysis/kyoto_period_group_products_20260908/`.

Their inclusion does not resolve the empirical limitations in `docs/release_scope.md`.
